scope: Replace generic inverse adapter/readback exposure with exact operation-specific contracts bound to the manifest operation, without dispatch or runtime mutation.

implemented.adapterEnvelope: packages/dicebox-compiler/src/staged-inverse-adapter.ts adds an exact selection plus Foundry inverse-operation envelope, validates stableId/kind correspondence, and recomputes the canonical operation hash before an adapter could be used.
implemented.adapterSurface: The adapter surface now exposes only deleteOwnedCreate and restoreUpdatePreimage with operation-specific readback results; generic readInverse, RuntimeBinding, and StagedReadback result exposure was removed.
implemented.readbackIdentity: Delete and restore readbacks are bound to manifestId, sequence, stableId, idempotencyKey, and operationSha256, and dispatch-state validation compares every identity field with the exact manifest operation.
implemented.deleteEvidence: Owned absence, preserved foreign conflict, and unknown delete outcomes are explicitly classified with binding-preservation and reread rules.
implemented.restoreEvidence: Restore evidence carries expectedPreimageSha256 and an independently observed payload digest; preimage-matched requires equality, not-found requires null evidence, and unknown cannot assert a match.
implemented.preservation: Foreign and unknown state remains visible and fail-closed; no adapter implementation, dispatch, receipt append, Foundry action, or runtime mutation was added.

validation.focused: 8 files / 27 tests passed across adapter contracts/readbacks, dispatch state, receipt ledger, pre-dispatch context, preflight orchestration, claim reread, and executor boundary contracts.
validation.fullGate: npm run check:full passed: workflow checker PASS (score 63; 10/16 gates), package and desktop builds passed, full Vitest passed 150 files / 765 tests, and tooling verification passed with no failures.
validation.databaseBeforeImplementation: M682 KB rebuild and read-only queries passed at 1103 sources / 943 facts / 810 decisions before implementation.
validation.workflowAfterImplementation: Active-slice checker remains PASS with Stage 11 proposal-approval-history as the only active stage and readyClaim false.

delegation: A hidden Sol Medium read-only architecture audit independently identified missing operation identity, weak restore evidence, generic adapter results, and the required fail-closed delete/restore states. The worker changed no files, the Foreman reviewed its receipt, and it was closed after integration review.
selectedNext: M684 code-only terminal receipt append/post-append reread resolution contract; keep adapter dispatch, Foundry action, runtime mutation, and Stage 11 acceptance excluded.
